cases.why: Lean 4 has NO cumulativity: Type 0 and Type 1 are unrelated and Prop is not Type 0. LOGOS admits Prop <= Type i <= Type j plus Pi variance (contravariant domain, covariant codomain) — Coq-style, strictly more permissive, and deliberate. It is defensible because the leniency is BOUNDED and the boundary is pinned by the test: is_subtype_normalized has arms only for Sort/Sort and Pi and delegates every other shape to def_eq, so a type ARGUMENT stays invariant and TList Prop is not a subtype of TList (Type 0). The cost is real and it belongs to a translator rather than to us: our acceptance set is strictly larger than Lean's in exactly the dimension a universe bug lives in, so the LOGOS kernel accepting a term is not evidence that the term is the Lean one. That is the corpus's tier-11 thesis, and it is why every other case in this tier is a MUST rather than a second divergence.

reduceBool/ofReduceBool are exactly Lean's Lean.reduceBool/Lean.ofReduceBool, so the shape is faithful and this is not a capability gap — we have native_decide. What differs is the trusted component behind it, and ours is the SMALLER commitment. Lean's native_decide trusts the Lean compiler and its runtime (Lean.trustCompiler): a compiled artefact no independent re-checker can see into. Ours trusts crate::eval, an in-repo CBV interpreter, hooked identically into reduction.rs's reduce_step and into recheck.rs's whnf — so the second, independently-written de Bruijn kernel still corroborates every term whose typing depends on the hook, which the test pins with a DoubleCheck::Agreed. The honest hazard is shared rather than ours alone: neither system checks that reduceBool's argument is the decide of the proposition being proved, and the test pins that too, on an ordinary definition with no decide in sight.

CLOSED 2026-09-15, vernacular-surface wave: `Repl::execute` is a SINGLE-command door and refuses a prefix (`ParseError::TrailingInput`), so a second `## Theorem` block can no longer be discarded in silence; `Repl::execute_document` is the document door and is fail-EARLY, so a false block anywhere refuses the document and nothing after it is registered. Concatenation no longer walks around the `concludes` gate.
